_about: Shared verdicts for site-declared tool definitions. Same file in pocketpaw (tests/fixtures/action_parity/) and paw-bar (app/tests/fixtures/action_parity/); change them in both. The limits are in expected.json bounds.
Each case is one tool as the server receives it in page.tools ({name, description, input_schema}); the frame gets the same tool as {name, description, inputSchema, confirm}. accept: kept | dropped.

Size is the length in characters of the compact JSON of input_schema (JS JSON.stringify(schema).length, Python len(json.dumps(schema, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False))). Size cases use integers and BMP text only, so both count alike. Text (tool and property descriptions) is measured after whitespace runs collapse to one space and the ends are trimmed.
lists: a whole page.tools list and the names kept, in order. Only the first tools_max entries are read, bad ones included; a bad tool drops alone; a repeated name keeps the first.

actions.js on the host page checks only an outline of these rules (name, description, execute, object schema, property names, size, count) to stay inside its gzip budget; the frame and the server apply all of them.
Never edit a verdict to make one side pass.
